members.name: id
members.doc: Stable id, used as the key and passed back on removal.

members.name: name
members.doc: File or item name shown on the chip.

members.name: detail
members.doc: Short note after the name, such as a size or a type.

members.name: id
members.doc: Value reported by `onModelChange` and `onSubmit`.

members.name: label
members.doc: Name shown on the trigger and in the menu.

members.name: description
members.doc: One line under the name in the menu.

members.name: value
members.doc: The trimmed prompt text.

members.name: attachments
members.doc: Attachments on the prompt when it was sent.

members.name: model
members.doc: Selected model id, when models are given.

types.name: PromptInputProps
types.doc: The prompt box of an assistant. It grows with the text up to `maxRows`, carries attachment chips and a model menu, and its send button turns into a stop button while `running` is true. Enter sends; Shift+Enter adds a line.

members.name: value
members.doc: Controlled text.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: Text the box starts with when uncontrolled.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called on every edit, and with an empty string after a send.

members.name: onSubmit
members.doc: Called when the person sends (Enter or the send button) with text or attachments present.

members.name: running
members.doc: True while a response is being generated: the send button becomes a stop button.

members.name: onStop
members.doc: Called when the stop button is pressed.

members.name: attachments
members.doc: Controlled attachment list.

members.name: defaultAttachments
members.doc: Attachments the box starts with when uncontrolled.

members.name: onAttachmentsChange
members.doc: Called when a chip is removed, files are picked, or the list is cleared after a send.

members.name: onAttach
members.doc: Called when the attach button is pressed. Without it the button opens the system file picker and adds the chosen files as chips.

members.name: models
members.doc: Models offered in the menu. The menu is hidden when the list is empty.

members.name: model
members.doc: Controlled model id.

members.name: defaultModel
members.doc: Model selected at first when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first one.

members.name: onModelChange
members.doc: Called when another model is picked.

members.name: placeholder
members.doc: Placeholder text of the empty box.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the text box.

members.name: maxRows
members.doc: Lines the box grows to before it scrolls.

members.name: clearOnSubmit
members.doc: Empties the text and the attachments after a send.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Blocks typing, attaching and sending.

members.name: container
members.doc: Render the model menu inside this element and limit collisions to it (used by the demo stages).

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.
